atomicChanges.newValue: Online access to certain confidential information is provided before initial training; access to the full Administration Manual is provided after successful completion of training.

oldEvidence.quote: After you sign the Franchise Agreement and when you begm mitial trammg, we will provide you with access to one copy of our Admmistration Manual, which may be provided through electronic means only

newEvidence.quote: After you sign the Franchise Agreement and before you begin initial training, you will be given online access to certain confidential information.
